0-20 clients:

I was doing everything. Fulfillment, strategy, sales calls, content, audits for every brand in the pipeline. All of it ran through me.

This is the phase where you learn the business inside and out because you literally have no choice. You are the business.

20-50 clients:

This is where everything almost broke.

I was still doing fulfillment and managing all the client strategy myself and it wasn't sustainable. So I made the hardest shift: I gave up fulfillment.

Brought on a Director of Ops to take the lead on client work execution.

A big shift was starting hiring people who actually had experience instead of just whoever I could

I’d rather have customers who buy because they want what I sell than customers who only show up for the discount.

Give them a new product, a limited run, something that’s only around for a few days. Put that in most of the next ten messages instead.
